p: Use CrewAI to build collaborative AI agent teams powered by Hanzo AI models. CrewAI's role-based agents work with any OpenAI-compatible provider.
API Key: Get yours at platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys · Fully OpenAI-compatible · every model on the gateway available
License: MIT · View source on GitHub →
Hanzo AI is OpenAI-compatible, so existing CrewAI code works with zero refactoring. We deeply appreciate the CrewAI / João Moura team for building and maintaining this open-source project.

code: pip install crewai import os os . environ [ " OPENAI_API_KEY " ] = " your-hanzo-api-key " os . environ [ " OPENAI_API_BASE " ] = " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " os . environ [ " OPENAI_MODEL_NAME " ] = " zen4-pro " from crewai import Agent , Task , Crew researcher = Agent ( role= " Researcher " , goal= " Find accurate information on AI trends " , backstory= " Expert AI researcher with deep knowledge " , ) writer = Agent ( role= " Writer " , goal= " Write compelling summaries " , backstory= " Technical writer specializing in AI " , )

task1 = Task ( description= " Research the latest LLM benchmarks " , expected_output= " A list of top 5 models and their scores " , agent=researcher , ) task2 = Task ( description= " Write a blog post based on the research " , expected_output= " 500-word blog post in markdown " , agent=writer , ) crew = Crew ( agents= [ researcher , writer ], tasks= [ task1 , task2 ]) result = crew . kickoff ()

from crewai import LLM hanzo_llm = LLM ( model= " zen4-pro " , api_key= " your-hanzo-api-key " , base_url= " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " , ) agent = Agent ( role= " Analyst " , goal= " Analyze data " , backstory= " Data analyst " , llm=hanzo_llm , )
pip install crewai export OPENAI_API_KEY= " your-hanzo-api-key " export OPENAI_BASE_URL= " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " crewai create my-crew
